title: Bookkeeper
description:
Senior Bookkeeper

Location: Northampton
Salary: Up to £40,000 DOE
Working Pattern: Full-Time or Part-Time (3 Days per Week Available)
Flexible Hours Available

The Opportunity

Are you an experienced Bookkeeper looking for a role that offers genuine flexibility and work-life balance?

We are supporting a friendly and growing independent accountancy practice in Northampton that prides itself on creating a supportive, low-pressure working environment. Whether you're looking for a full-time position or a part-time role across three days per week, this opportunity can be tailored around you.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys bookkeeping, likes working closely with a varied portfolio of clients, and wants the satisfaction of a job well done without the stress of taking work home. If you're looking for a position where you can come to work, make a real difference to clients, and leave work at the door at the end of the day, this could be the perfect fit.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing bookkeeping for a portfolio of SME clients across various sectors
- Processing sales and purchase ledger transactions
- Bank reconciliations and cashbook management
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns
- Maintaining accurate financial records and client accounts
- Assisting with management accounts preparation
- Liaising with clients to resolve bookkeeping queries
- Supporting year-end accounts preparation
- Processing journals, accruals and prepayments where required
- Using cloud accounting software such as Xero, QuickBooks and Sage

About You
- Previous bookkeeping experience within an accountancy practice environment
- Strong knowledge of double-entry bookkeeping principles
- Experience preparing and submitting VAT returns
- Familiarity with cloud-based accounting systems
- Organised with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable managing your own workload and client relationships
- AAT qualified or qualified by experience candidates welcome

What's on Offer?
- Salary up to £40,000 depending on experience
- Full-time or part-time options available
- Flexible working hours to fit around your lifestyle
- Friendly and supportive team environment
- Varied client portfolio
- Free parking
- Genuine work-life balance
- Stable role with long-term career security

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Bookkeeper seeking flexibility, autonomy and a welcoming practice environment where work-life balance is genuinely valued.

title: Credit Controller
description:
As a Credit Controller in the business services industry, based in Northampton, you'll play a key role in managing and maintaining the company's credit and collections processes. Your day-to-day will involve ensuring timely payments, resolving account queries, and supporting the smooth running of the accounting and finance department.

Client Details

A company in the business services industry located in Northampton.

Description

Manage and recover outstanding debt relating to fees across multiple locations.

Review and prioritise aged debt ledgers, focusing on high-value and long-outstanding accounts.

Contact responsible parties by telephone, email and letter to secure payment of overdue balances.

Investigate and resolve account queries, disputed charges and billing discrepancies that may delay payment.

Negotiate payment arrangements and repayment plans in line with company policies.

Monitor agreed payment schedules and follow up on broken arrangements.

Liaise closely with Regional Managers and Finance teams to obtain information required to support debt recovery activities.

Maintain accurate records of all communications, payment commitments and collection activity.

Escalate high-risk or non-responsive accounts through the appropriate internal and legal recovery processes.

Reconcile customer accounts and allocate payments accurately.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller should have:
- Previous experience in credit control or a similar role within accounting and finance.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills.
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational abilities.
- Confident communication skills to liaise with clients and internal teams.
- Proficiency in relevant accounting software and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.
- The ability to work efficiently under pressure and meet deadlines.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and resolving account issues.

Job Offer
- Competitive salary of up to £32,000, dependent on the level of experience.
- Permanent position based in Northampton.
- Opportunity to work in the business services industry.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Experienced Legal Assistant Commercial Property
description:
Experienced Legal Assistant Commercial Property
Salary: £27,000 - £30,000 DOE
Location: Northampton

SJC Legal is currently working with a well-established and highly regarded law firm looking to recruit an experienced Legal Assistant to join its growing Commercial Property team in Northampton.

This is an excellent opportunity for an established Legal Assistant or Legal Secretary who enjoys working within a busy property department and is looking for a long-term legal support position. You will work closely with experienced Commercial Property fee earners, providing essential administrative and transactional support and playing an important role in the smooth running of the department.

The Benefits
- Competitive salary depending on experience
- Full-time, permanent position
- Opportunity to join an established and expanding Commercial Property team
- Work directly alongside experienced Commercial Property fee earners
- Exposure to a broad range of commercial property transactions
- Established and highly regarded regional law firm
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Varied and responsible legal support position

The Role
- Provide day-to-day administrative and legal support to Commercial Property fee earners
- Assist with the progression of commercial property transactions
- Submit online property searches
- Prepare and submit Land Registry applications
- Assist with the completion and submission of Stamp Duty Land Tax returns
- Support the team with quality, compliance and file management requirements
- Prepare, format, scan and organise legal documentation and correspondence
- Maintain accurate records using the firm's Case Management system
- Manage competing priorities and expectations across multiple fee earners
- Liaise professionally with clients and other third parties
- Provide additional administrative support to other teams when required

The Candidate
- Be an experienced Legal Assistant, Legal Secretary or Property Assistant
- Have previous experience working within a legal property environment
- Commercial Property experience would be highly advantageous
- Have strong administrative skills and excellent attention to detail
- Be confident using Case Management systems
- Audio typing and digital dictation experience would be advantageous but is not essential
- Be comfortable working in an administrative and legal support-focused position
- Have excellent organisation and time management skills
- Be able to prioritise competing workloads and work effectively to strict deadlines
- Have a professional and confident telephone manner
- Be proactive, adaptable and enthusiastic with a strong team-focused approach

How to Apply
For a confidential discussion regarding this opportunity, or to discuss other legal support and Commercial Property positions currently available, please contact Alex Wilcock, Legal Recruitment Consultant at SJC Legal.

title: Payroll Administrator
company: Infinity Recruitment Consultancy Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Our superb client, based in Northampton, is seeking an experienced Payroll Administrator to join them on a part time permanent basis working 20 hours per week Monday to Friday. Flexibility will be required with the working hours during busy periods.

As Payroll Administrator, you will be responsible for end-to-end payroll processing, making adjustments and amendments, dealing with payroll queries, processing expenses, pension information, bonuses and additional benefits, maintenance of holidays, looking after company business credit cards, preparing monthly management information and reporting, regulatory reporting, adhering to compliance requirements and other related payroll duties.

To be considered for the role of Payroll Administrator, you will have recent and previous end-to-end payroll experience, knowledge of current payroll legislation, strong numerical skills, proficiency in Excel to intermediate level and exceptional attention to detail.

In return, our client is offering a salary of £32,000 - £38,000 (full time equivalent) so £17,778 - £21,111 depending on experience for the part time hours, pension, DIS and private healthcare (after qualifying period), 26 days annual leave plus bank holidays, social events and much more.

Send your CV now for consideration and review.

Infinity Recruitment Consultancy Limited acts as an employment agency for permanent, contract and temporary recruitment. By applying you will be registered as a candidate with Infinity Recruitment Consultancy Limited, your personal data may be added to our database as part of the application process. Our privacy policy is available on our website and explains how we will use your data.

title: Receptionist
description: Receptionist is responsible for undertaking a wide range of reception duties and providing support to the multidisciplinary team. Duties may include, but are not limited to, greeting and directing patients, effective use of the appointment system, booking appointments, processing of personal information and assisting patients as required. To act as a central point of contact for patients, the distribution of information, messages and enquiries for the clinical team, liaising with the multidisciplinary team member and external agencies such as secondary care and community service providers. The core responsibilities of the receptionist are as follows. On occasion, there may be a requirement to carry out tasks not listed below, that are within the reasonable scope of the role. Maintain and monitor practice appointment system Process personal, telephone and e-requests for appointments Answer incoming phone calls, dealing with the callers request appropriately Signpost patients to the correct service Initiating contact with and responding to, requests from patients, team members and external agencies Data entry of new and temporary registrations and relevant patient information as requested Input data as necessary onto patients healthcare records Direct requests for information to relevant team members i.e., SAR, DVLA forms, insurance/solicitors letters Manage all queries as necessary in an efficient manner Carry out system searches as requested Support all clinical staff with general tasks as required Photocopy documentation as required Maintain a clean, tidy and effective working area Monitor and maintain the reception area and notice boards In addition to the core responsibilities, the Receptionist may be requested to; 1. Action incoming emails and correspondence as necessary 2. Complete opening and closing procedures in accordance with the rota 3. Partake in audit as directed by the audit lead 4. Support admin team, providing cover during absences 5. Scan patient related documents and attach scanned documents to patients healthcare record

title: Receptionist/Administrator
description: We are a busy 11,000 patient GP practice in Northamptonshire looking for an Receptionist/Administrator for hours to be arranged to join our friendly team. Opening hours 8.00am - 6.30pm Monday to Friday. We would be looking for someone who can provide flexible cover during opening times. This is a fast-paced and varied role that requires excellent communication skills and the ability to remain calm under pressure. You will manage a range of administrative and patient-facing tasks, ensuring the smooth running of our daily clinics. Greeting patients and visitors both in person and over the telephone. Booking, cancelling, and rescheduling appointments via the SystmOne clinical system. Processing repeat prescription requests and handling diverse patient enquiries. Managing incoming and outgoing post, clinical coding tasks, and scanning documentation. Assist with ad-hoc administrative tasks as needed. Liaising with GPs, nurses, and external healthcare providers (e.g., secondary care and pharmacies). Maintaining patient confidentiality and data protection (GDPR) at all times. You will play a vital role in ensuring the efficient day-to-day operations of the practice. Your responsibilities will include welcoming patients, managing appointment scheduling, handling incoming calls, and supporting the administrative team with various clerical tasks. The ideal candidate will be organised, detail-oriented, and skilled in providing excellent customer service to patients and visitors. Your contribution will help create a welcoming atmosphere that enhances patient experience, while upholding confidentiality and adhering to healthcare regulations and practice policies.
